description: Create an insight channel for a collection: AI-written analysis of the collection's latest articles, delivered on a schedule. Ask the user first: do they want one, how often (default daily at 6:00 AM their time), and which format (list_insight_formats; default is a briefing tailored to the collection type). Ask their time zone if you don't know it. Each run spends credits; the first run starts immediately unless run_now is false.

frequency.description: How often it runs. Default daily.

run_now.description: Run once now so the channel isn't empty. Default true.

timezone.description: The user's IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York. Ask the user if you don't know it; if omitted, their daily brief's zone (else America/New_York) is used.

name: create_insight_channel
title: Create insight channel
